lines.en: Yet another inconsistency in weather has prompted me to seek out a means of thermoregulation as I make my way over to the bath house.
And while this constant swapping of cold for heat and heat for cold does wonders in keeping me on my toes, sometimes I just want to feel a lot of one thing.
Normally, that thing is sadness. Or boner. But tonight, that thing is being hot. So I will submerge myself fully in the hottest water I can find while some girl with green hair complains to me.
: Welcome in!
: Wow. You look different today, Io.
: Really? Must be my new medication. One of the potential side effects was larger boobs and purple eyes.
: Don’t worry. I still like you more than Uta either way.
: Hey! That hurts! Even if you already knew it was me and you’re only saying that to get on my nerves!
: Oh, wow. Is that actually you, Uta?
: Stop pretending you don’t immediately recognize me! I have a complex, remember?!
: I just don’t think I can know for sure it’s you unless you flash me.
: Ah-hah! A trick! Now there’s the Sensei I know and love.

: Which means I must now apologize as what you are asking is beyond the capabilities of what I am legally allowed to do as an employee of the bath house and the daughter of parents who are already very disappointed in me.
: They don’t need to know.
: They do, though. You know the rule. No freaky business until there’s a really uncomfortable phone call.
: How would that call even go?
: Probably like...
: Hi, Mom! Hi, Dad! It’s your beloved little girl, Uta! So — remember that time you made me move to Kumon-mi because some creepy old guy wanted to screw me?
: Yeah. Well, that’s happening again. But I like him this time so I want your permission to-
: What’s that? I need to move again? Darn!
: Then a helicopter comes and carries me away to Nagano or something where the cycle repeats and I fall for someone else who’s way too old for me.
: Which is precisely why you should avoid the phone call entirely and just flash and/or marry me already.
: Did you bring a ring this time?
: No.
: Then both of your wishes will not come true!
: What are you even doing here, Uta? Where’s Io? And...is that her robe?
: Oh, no. I have my own. I help out here sometimes when Io and her aunt can’t make it. They’re at the doctor’s office right now.
: The doctor’s office? Is everything-
: Totally fine, no worries. Doctors just make you do this thing sometimes where you have to physically show up if you want to keep getting the good stuff.
: So Io and her aunt make a big trip once a year where they just try to knock out as many of her doctors as they can in one go. They won’t be back until tomorrow.
: Wouldn’t it make more sense for her to just have everything prescribed by one doctor?
: Yeah. I think there might be some kinda fraud thing going on. I haven’t ruled out that Io’s aunt isn’t running a secret drug cartel yet.
: Oh great, another subplot.

: Either way! Yours truly is here to make sure that you and anyone else can get naked with ease! Now please hand over your wallet as you so normally do, Sensei. Tipping is not mandatory, but expected.
: I have never had to tip Io in my life.
: Do I look like Io to you?
: Like I said, I can’t be convinced you’re really Uta until you flash me.
: Well, I’m not gonna flash you before I’m paid. I don’t show these babies to just anybody, Sensei. It’s not 2015 anymore.
: See, we’re going to have a problem then. I didn't bring my wallet because Io stopped charging me a long time ago and just lets me bathe for free now.
: And why should Uta do the same?
: Because she’ll get to see my penis on the cameras I know she has access to.
: And faint again?! You saw what happened the last time you showed me that thing! I was out for like twelve hours!
: Technically, I didn’t show you. You busted in and saw it on your own.
: Maybe I thought Io was in danger?! That thing was so big I could feel its presence from all the way down here!
: Can you feel it now, Uta?
: Mh?!
: Can you feel my penis?
: Okay, fine! You don’t have to pay me! Just take that thing outta here before it robs the register and impregnates everyone within a five mile radius!
: Nice. Thanks, Uta. Enjoy the camera feed.
: I will! I-I mean I won’t! Because we definitely don’t have one!
: Feel free to join if-
: OKAY BYE!
: Come on, come on, come on...
: Hello?
: Io, we’ve got a code blue over here.
: Someone died? Why is it always on my day off?
: Nobody died! But somebody is about to die and that somebody is me!
: Uta, I understand that Tsuneyo girl may be considered “conventionally attractive” by all of you. But if she’s there again, please don’t use the cameras to-
: No! I mean Sensei is here right now! He’s getting undressed as we speak!
: Oh.
: So what?
: What do you mean SO WHAT?! How am I supposed to deal with this?!
: By...continuing to sit at the counter and helping other customers who come in?
: Oh...yeah. I guess that makes sense. Sorry for the false alarm.
: Or you could go have sex with him.
: PHBHTBHTHBTHBTHTHTHTH?!?!?!
: What?!
: Yeah. Use my bed, though. Don’t make the bath all gross, please.
: What do you think you’re saying, Io?!
: What? That’s what you...sex people do, right? Spare me the details, though. And please thoroughly clean my sheets when you’re done.
: I don’t want to have sex yet! I’m not ready!
: You sure sound ready. Your voice is like two octaves higher than normal.
: Because penis, Io! Sensei penis! So close to Uta! What do?!
: Dude, what do you want me to tell you? Either do stuff or don’t do stuff. You like him, right? This could be your shot.
: But you like him too! And I’m at your house! It’s sacrilegious!
: Technically, it’s my aunt’s house. Do you want to talk to her?
: NO! OBVIOUSLY NOT!
: Cool! Bye then! Have fun!
: Io, you don’t- AAAAH! SHE HUNG UP!
: WHAT AM I SUPPOSED TO DO?!?!?!?!
It was a sticky situation for Uta Ushibori — a girl who had just recently brought her “I’ve masturbated to my teacher” count into the triple digits.
Because on one hand, she was perfectly capable of sitting behind the counter and just serving customers like Io suggested.
But on the other, this was a perfect opportunity to try and take things up a notch with someone she’d been borderline obsessing over for months, if not years on end now.
The days all seemed to blur together. But in the midst of that incessant fog, there was one thing that was abundantly and permanently clear.
She had not learned a thing.
: Um...Ahem...
: I like where this is going.
: Y...You don’t mind if I join you, right?
: I...I uhhhh closed. The...shop. Early. B-But there are still some customers in the women’s side, so...
: So you’d rather be naked and alone with your male teacher instead of other women.
: It sounds so...impure when you...put it that way...
: Probably because it is. You know what you’re doing right now.
: That’s...uhh...yeah! I...know...but...
: D...Don’t just put me on the spot like that, Sensei...
: Just because I know doesn’t...mean it’s not...embarrassing...
: I want to destroy you.
: Hm? What? I didn’t-
: Nothing. Just know that you are putting yourself at risk by doing this and that I am not going to stop staring at you for the rest of the night.
: Y...You can stare. I like it when...you stare, but...uhh...
: B-Before you start! Can you give me, like...five seconds to take my towel off and get in the bath?
: You are going to walk in here looking like that and then tell me I can’t watch the best part?
: B-Baby steps! Okay? We’ll...um...yeah. You’re...hot. Wow. Uhh. What was I...towel! Right. Towel. Eyes! Close. Five...s...seconds.
: P...Please...
: M...Master...
: Fine. But only because you called me “Master.”
: Yes, Master! Anything for you, Master!
: Anything? Then you don’t mind if I-
: Ah! Aaah! No! Eyes! Keep closed! Almost there! No peeping! I’ll scream!
: You’re screaming now.
: If you think this is bad, you should hear what’s going on inside of my head!
It was a cacophony of unrepentant lust aimed directly at the heart and cock of a man who excelled when it came to the latter, but was completely undeveloped in terms of the former.
This was quite the contrast to Uta Ushibori — a girl who, while ravenously horny, still prioritized love and affection over carnal desire.
It would be so easy for her to just traipse her way over to the opposite end of the bath and ride this man until both of them passed out from heat exhaustion, but she kept her distance.
She covered herself up — and while some of that was designed to tease him and keep him wanting more, a greater portion of it was brought on by uncertainty.
She’d accepted she wouldn’t be the first. But if she timed things properly, she believed she could still be the last.

It was that type of immature and wishful thinking that kept her broken, though. For she was chasing after the right thing — just it was, at the risk of sounding repetitive, on the opposite end as well.
: You can open your eyes now.
: Tch. I was hoping you’d be closer when I heard those words.
: Are you not as tempted to try and do naughty stuff to me when I’m all the way over here?
: My penis might be big, but it’s not that big, Uta.
: I don’t know about that, Sen...Master. I’ve seen lots of penises in my time on the Internet and I...definitely think you’ve got them all beat if I’m remembering correctly.
: If you need a reminder-
: No! Totally fine! I can only handle so much!
: If you insist.
: Hahah.....hah......yeah....
: So you’ve, like...been here with other girls before, right?
: A few times. Not always on the same side of the fence, though.
: But...sometimes...right?
: Sometimes you’ve...been in here with other girls.
: Right...
: You ever like...you know...
: Why? You want details?
: Just...curious.
: Then no. I have never done anything inappropriate in here with anyone before. Which is actually...kind of surprising.
: Surprising cause you...waaaant to? Or you just feel like that would be a...normal thing for you to do at this point?
: Is this line of questioning leading anywhere in particular, Uta?
: Just...you know...
: Trying to see how different we are.
: I’ve never done anything like this before. Be...so close to someone I’m interested in while...so vulnerable...you know?
: Like, I’m trusting you with all of me right now and it’s...really intimate.
: It makes me really happy.
: And I don’t use that term “intimate” lightly. I know I’ve...done some questionable and...stupid stuff in the past. But that was all sorta...fake intimacy, you know?
: Right now is like...real. Really real. And I’m scared but I’m...comfortable.
: This seems really heavy coming from someone who was trying to get me to pay her to flash me just ten minutes ago.
: Th-That was not real! This is different!
: So if I offer to pay you now-
: I’ll question why you suddenly have your wallet again when you told me you left it at home. Then probably deny your request again because I’m nervous and horny.
: Say that again please. Nervous and what now?
: ...horny.
: I like this.
: You’re, like...really hot...and I’m a...pervert, so...
: You’re not the...only one who has it really hard right now...
: Yeah. “Really hard” is an understatement.
: Oh my god, this was a terrible idea.
: There’s nothing to be ashamed about, Uta. If anything, I’m the one who should be ashamed right now because I am supposed to know better.
: And I’m not?
: Some people would say this is the craziest thing I’ve done yet, Master.
: You can go back to “Sensei” now. We’re being real with each other. No need to use nicknames.
: Then...can I use your real name?
: Do you know it?
: Akira...right?
: I...guess you do.
: We all...kinda know now. Word gets around and stuff.
: Well...sure. I guess you can call me that then.
: Akira...
: It’s a good name.
: How do you spell it?
: With autumn and music.
: Music?
: Or comfort. Ease. Whichever one you like most.
: The first one, obviously! We can match that way!
: That’s why I said it.
: Huh?
: Well, you were trying to see how different we are, right?
: Maybe we’re not so different at all at the end of the day.
: Granted, your name is much prettier than mine.
: I don’t think I agree...Akira.

: Like, maybe your name on its own isn’t super unique. But at least the way you write it is cool. Everybody else is like “bright” or “light” or something. Which wouldn’t really fit you at all, would it?
: You mean to tell me you can look at me and not see a massive ball of sunshine?
: No, autumn is way better! Not quite summer, yet not quite winter. Warm colors, but chill weather. At least...typically.
: It fits you.
: And Uta fits you. Perhaps too well.
: Heheh. My parents say the same thing. They always joke about how they knew I’d be a song. Cheerful. Exciting. Someone who’d appeal to everyone.
: Just...took me a little while to grow into that.
: Yeah. I’m still growing into my name too.
: It’s really okay that I call you that? It doesn’t make you feel weird or anything?
: Well, do you feel weird when I call you Uta?
: Define weird? Because it does give me butterflies. But I get those whenever you’re around in the first place, so maybe I’m just noticing more of them now?
: God, you are so fucking cute.
: You can have me forever so long as you buy a riiiiiing~
: You could also just buy yourself one with all of the money I have given you.
: Not the saaaaame!
: I’m well aware. But if we talk any more about a future where I can have you all to myself, I’m going to come over there and actually destroy you. So yeah.
: Yeah, I’m like five lines away from throwing myself at you too. This sexual tension is seriously killing me.
: Which means we either need to get out now or have sex.
: Well, figure it out right now because I only have four lines left.
: Uhh...we could go watch a movie or something?
: There is zero way that would not end sexually.
: Well, why are we even avoiding that if we both want it?
: The timing isn’t right. One line left.
: Does this count as edging you?
: Yes, and it’s hell!
: But I know a place where we can go be alone and not be tempted to do sexy stuff!
: You underestimate just how many locations I am willing to have sex in. Also, I’m pretty sure you’ve passed your five lines and are supposed to be throwing yourself at me right now.
: Fine! Close your eyes and get ready for my body! Here it comes!
: Done. But if you-
: UTA-CHAN ESCAPE ROUTE GOOOOO!
Uta manages to snatch her towel and exit the bathing area so quickly that I’m not-
Well, I’m not sure what exactly. But I do know that this raging erection is going to need to wait until it tastes her flesh.
I’ve grown used to her teasing, though. And honestly, I’d be fine with it lasting for the rest of our lives. But chances are, one of us is going to explode by then.
Will it be me? Will it be her? There’s no way to know until we let the future play out.
And in the event that it doesn’t play out the way we want...
Maybe we can just reset?
Uta’s affection has increased to [uta_love]!
